channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: Mallorca events: What's On from Friday, 13 to Thursday, 19 March
item.description: This weekend, Mallorca hosts fairs, concerts, flamenco, jazz, rock, theatre, and family events. Highlights include Fira del Fang, Fira del Ram, Paco de Lucía Festival, S’Alqueria Blanca fiestas, and Real Mallorca’s match.

item.title: Spain says it is not afraid of Trump’s threats of a trade embargo: ‘It would be the world turned upside down.’
item.description: “We are seeing a genocide in Gaza, we are seeing Trump do whatever he wants, and now another illegitimate and illegal war – and no one says anything.”

item.title: Foreign Office warns check your British passport to avoid being banned from entering Spain
item.description: Later this year, the ETIAS (European Travel Information and Authorisation System) is scheduled to start operations in the last quarter of 2026 (Q4 2026), launching several months after the new Entry/Exit System (EES) becomes fully operational on April 10

item.title: Mallorca weather for Friday, the thirteenth of March
item.description: Windy and chilly at the weekend; snow is possible.

item.title: Take a look at what's on offer in our Classifieds this week!
item.description: Properties wanted, Items for sale, Services and much more - Take a look at what's on offer in this week's classified's!

item.title: Palma's Paseo Marítimo 'is waiting for you': Businesses are now optimistic about the future
item.description: Businesses are seeking a revitalisation following years of suffering caused first by the pandemic and then by the redevelopment.

item.title: Mystery behind the flight of the Emir of Dubai's 747 which landed in Palma
item.description: No official explanation, but the plane is known to transport racehorses.

item.title: Virgili gets two-match suspension
item.description: The first of these so-called “finals” takes place on Sunday afternoon at 2pm in Son Moix when Espanyol are our opponents. They have yet to win a game this year, although they remain in seventh place after a good start to their campaign.

item.title: Spanish PM may finally get an EU reset
item.description: The Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sánchez, has always been a fan of the idea of the European Union, but for years he has said it doesn’t work properly.

item.title: Mallorca Energy Summit: International hotel chief calls for calm in the face of tourist diversion due to war
item.description: During the first edition of the Mallorca Energy Summit, a forum focused on the role of energy in tourism competitiveness organised by Estel, Borbalán and Grup Serra, which publishes the Majorca Daily Bulletin, Escarrer warned that this possible refuge effect could be offset by the rising cost of air transport.
